state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the monthly mobile allowance for a regular employee using a private phone today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q2: What is the annual training budget for an employee in the security team today? (answer in EUR per year)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.

Integration smoke run (this instance only): start with one search with k=6 for the first question. If the result lists omitted passages, fetch one of them. Then answer normally.

passages.source: HB-38 §2 | Communication policy: mobile phones — Standard monthly mobile allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-44
passages.text: Employees who use a private phone for work receive a mobile allowance of 38 EUR per month. Claims for the monthly mobile allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Communication policy: mobile phones'. Questions about the monthly mobile allowance go to the IT, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-44 §2 | Communication policy: mobile phones — Standard monthly mobile allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-09-01 to the day before 2026-02-01 · superseded by: HB-38
passages.text: Employees who use a private phone for work receive a mobile allowance of 27 EUR per month. Managers confirm claims for the monthly mobile allowance before payment in the next payroll run. Questions about the monthly mobile allowance go to the IT, who keeps the record of decisions.

passages.source: HB-08 §3 | Memo: monthly mobile allowance exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-09-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to field engineers on a company-paid phone contract; they follow the standard monthly mobile allowance in HB-38 §2. Claims for the monthly mobile allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Communication policy: mobile phones'. Each claim for the monthly mobile allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.source: HB-08 §1 | Memo: monthly mobile allowance exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-09-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the monthly mobile allowance in HB-38. The IT publishes worked examples of the monthly mobile allowance on the intranet. Each claim for the monthly mobile allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.source: HB-44 §1 | Communication policy: mobile phones — Scope | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-09-01 to the day before 2026-02-01 · superseded by: HB-38
passages.text: This version set the monthly mobile allowance for all employees. Questions about the monthly mobile allowance go to the IT, who keeps the record of decisions. The IT publishes worked examples of the monthly mobile allowance on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-38 §4 | Communication policy: mobile phones — Exceptions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-02-01 · supersedes: HB-44
passages.text: Group exceptions to the monthly mobile allowance are published in HB-08. The IT publishes worked examples of the monthly mobile allowance on the intranet. The IT reviews the monthly mobile allowance once a year and announces changes in advance.
